move: two panels slide in from opposite sides, mirrored pan, word swap
how: Two rounded video panels stacked vertically slide in simultaneously from opposite sides (xPercent ∓110, expo.out 0.9s) while their footage pans in mirror (xPercent -60→-40 and -40→-60, scale 1.25→1.08, linear over D). Labels drop in, a big word rises from a mask, a centre rule draws and a VS badge spins in with back.out(2). At 0.44D both panels nudge outward ∓3% and spring back while the badge turns 360 with expo.inOut; at 0.6D the words exit up, textContent swaps and new words rise. At 0.88D both panels leave the way they came with expo.in, badge and rule collapse.
adapt: Replace the two videos, Before/After labels, the two word pairs (the swap uses textContent sets) and the badge/footer text; keep the simultaneous expo.out entrance and mirrored pan for the synced feel.
port: mount(el, shot) builds two .panel blocks, .mid, .badge and .foot and waits on video loadeddata; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the video-scrub onUpdate tween and offsets as fractions of D (beat at 2.2/5, swap at 3.0/5, exit at 4.4/5). Scope selectors to el.
caveats: backdrop-filter blur on labels and mix-blend-mode grade over video are render costs
video scrub via currentTime requires loaded media
both panels use the same video file
